title: Product Context (merged PRD.md + .factory/stack.yaml)
description: Contract for the machine context a product exposes to Factory skills. A product is authored in TWO files split by author: PRD.md frontmatter (human-owned: product, domain, meta) and .factory/stack.yaml (machine-owned, written by /plan-arch: tech_stack, commands, skills, guardrails, escalation_policy, tech_bindings). `fac sync-context` merges them, derives the compatibility aliases, validates the result against this schema, and writes .factory/context.gen.yaml. Each property carries an `x-owner` annotation naming the file that authors it. This schema is a genuine superset of the agent-skills project-context schema: every key that library defines is reproduced below so vendored craft skills bind unchanged.

product.description: Product identity. Authored by a human in PRD.md frontmatter.

name.description: Product name. Non-empty — an untouched template must not validate.

project.description: COMPAT ALIAS — do not author. Derived from `product` by `fac sync-context` because the agent-skills library requires a `project` key. Vendored craft skills bind to this.

domain.description: One-line domain statement. Sets the frame for domain-knowledge craft skills.

tech_stack.description: Languages allowed for this product and the per-component choices made at design time by /plan-arch. Drives Implementer craft-skill routing.

languages.description: Allowed language set for this product.

commands.description: Per-component command config (read -> ask -> persist). Keys are component names plus optional top-level 'deploy'.

tech_bindings.description: Concrete infrastructure a skill may target. `fac sync-context` derives entries from tech_stack.components[] (per-component stack, plus `db`); values authored here win over derived ones. Required by library skills that bind ${ctx.tech_bindings}.

cache.description: Caching layer, e.g. 'redis', 'none'. Audited for cache-poisoning / authz-bypass (OWASP A01/A05).

auth.description: Authn/authz provider or strategy, e.g. 'auth0', 'oidc', 'session-cookie', 'jwt'. Audited by /security (access management, RBAC, tokens — OWASP A01/A07, API BOLA/BFLA).

crypto.description: Encryption / key-management binding, e.g. 'aws-kms', 'libsodium', 'webcrypto'. The Factory rolls no crypto itself; audited for weak/rolled-your-own crypto (OWASP A02).

session.description: Session strategy, e.g. 'stateless-jwt', 'redis-session', 'signed-cookie'. Audited for fixation / weak lifetime (OWASP A07).

tls.description: Transport security posture for public endpoints, e.g. 'lets-encrypt', 'acm', 'cloudflare'. /deploy hard-gates a public deploy on a valid chain + min TLS version + HSTS via lib/tls-verify.ts (OWASP A02/A05).

mobile_release.description: Per-store app-store release bindings (Phase 6). Records bundle_id/application_id, the release track, the release tool (fastlane/EAS/Codemagic), and WHICH CI holds the signing material — never the secret value (custody principle, §6.2). /deploy hard-gates a store submission and verifies the release manifest (format, monotonic build, valid track, no embedded secret) via lib/mobile-release-verify.ts.

apple.description: Apple App Store: bundle_id, track (testflight|app-store), tool, and the CI that holds the distribution cert + provisioning profile + ASC API key.

google.description: Google Play: application_id, track (internal|closed|production), tool, and the CI that holds the upload keystore + Play service-account JSON (prefer Play App Signing).

supply_chain.description: Supply-chain security bindings (Phase 7, Track 1). Records the SCA scanner (osv-scanner/npm-audit/pip-audit/trivy), the severity policy the gate enforces, and the SBOM format. The scan + SBOM run in CI; /security normalises the output and /ship + /deploy hard-gate on a fix-available finding at or above the threshold via lib/sca-report.ts (custody principle — the Factory runs no scanner and fetches no advisory feed itself).

sca_tool.description: The dependency-vulnerability scanner, chosen per language/ecosystem. osv-scanner is multi-ecosystem (npm, PyPI, Pub, ...).

block_severity.description: Findings at or above this severity are gate candidates. Default: high.

require_fix_available.description: When true (default), a finding only blocks if a fix exists — an unfixable CVE warns but never holds the release.

sbom_format.description: The Software Bill of Materials format the build emits.

sast.description: Static Application Security Testing bindings (Phase 7, Track 2). Records the static analyzer (semgrep/codeql) and the severity the gate enforces. The scan runs in CI; /security normalises the output (SARIF or semgrep JSON) and gates on a finding at or above the threshold via lib/sast-report.ts — advisory in /review, gating in /security. No fix-available axis: the vulnerable code is yours to fix.

tool.description: The static analyzer. semgrep (rulesets) or CodeQL (where available). Both can emit SARIF.

format.description: The analyzer's output shape lib/sast-report.ts parses. SARIF covers CodeQL and `semgrep --sarif`.

block_severity.description: Findings at or above this severity gate. Default: high.

provenance.description: Artifact-signing + build-provenance bindings (Phase 7, Track 3). Records the keyless signer (cosign/Sigstore), the attestation format (SLSA provenance), and the expected identity/issuer/builder/source a verifier must confirm. Signing + attestation run in CI; the Factory holds no signing key (keyless OIDC, custody principle §6.2). /deploy hard-gates a release, verifying the attestation against these expectations via lib/provenance-verify.ts.

signer.description: The keyless signer. cosign (Sigstore) signs with a short-lived Fulcio cert bound to an OIDC identity — no long-lived key.

attestation_format.description: The build-provenance attestation format. SLSA provenance records what built the artifact and from which source.

expected_identity.description: The OIDC certificate identity the signature must carry, e.g. the release workflow URI. Exact match unless identity_is_regex.

identity_is_regex.description: When true, expected_identity is a regular-expression source string.

expected_builder_id.description: The SLSA provenance builder id, e.g. https://github.com/actions/runner.

expected_source_uri.description: The source repo URI the provenance must attest, e.g. git+https://github.com/org/repo.

require_transparency_log.description: When true (default), the signature must be recorded in a transparency log (Rekor).

require_keyless.description: When true (default), reject a long-lived-key signature — keyless OIDC signing only.

ci.description: CI/CD pipeline bindings (Phase 7, Track 4). Records the CI provider and the hardening baseline a generated pipeline must meet: least-privilege permissions, OIDC/keyless cloud auth (no long-lived secret), pinned action SHAs, and the required security steps (SCA/SBOM/SAST/sign). /pipeline generates the workflow and /security audits an existing one; both check it via lib/pipeline-lint.ts (custody principle — the Factory holds no push secret).

provider.description: The CI/CD provider. GitHub Actions first; the mechanism-vs-parameters model lets a second provider be a binding, not a rewrite.

oidc_identity.description: The OIDC subject the pipeline authenticates as, e.g. the release workflow URI federated to the cloud/registry — no long-lived secret.

require_oidc.description: When true (default), the pipeline must request `id-token: write` for keyless auth.

require_pinned_actions.description: When true (default), every third-party `uses:` must be pinned to a full 40-hex commit SHA.

required_steps.description: Substrings that must each appear in at least one pipeline step, e.g. the SCA/SAST/sign commands wired as required checks.

container_scan.description: Container-image scanning + base-image hardening bindings (Phase 7, Track 5 — optional, for products that ship a Docker image). Records the image scanner (trivy/grype), the severity policy, and the hardening rules. The scan runs in CI; /security normalises the output and gates on a fix-available finding at/above the threshold via lib/container-scan.ts, and lints the image config (non-root user, pinned base image).

block_severity.description: Image vulns at or above this severity are gate candidates. Default: high.

require_fix_available.description: When true (default), a vuln only blocks if a fix exists — an unfixable one warns.

forbid_root.description: When true (default), an image that runs as root fails the hardening lint.

require_pinned_base.description: When true (default), the base image must be pinned by digest (FROM img@sha256:...), not a tag.

dast.description: Dynamic Application Security Testing bindings (Phase 7, Track 5 — optional). Records the DAST scanner (OWASP ZAP baseline) and the risk policy. The scan runs in CI against a deployed preview; /security normalises the ZAP output and gates on a confirmed alert at/above the risk threshold via lib/dast-report.ts.

scanner.description: The DAST scanner. OWASP ZAP baseline scan against a running preview.

block_risk.description: Alerts at or above this risk gate. Default: high.

min_confidence.description: Alerts below this confidence are treated as noise and never gate. Default: low.

skills.description: Manifest of skills this product has adopted, with optional per-skill overrides.

name.description: Skill folder name (Layer 1 workflow or vendored craft).

version.description: Pinned version copied from source (craft skills).

layer.description: Architecture layer this skill maps to.

budget.description: Per-run cost budget (plan §8.1). Warns, does not halt, until a measured baseline exists.

escalation_policy.description: When and how to escalate / defer to humans.

jurisdictions.description: LIBRARY KEY — applicable jurisdictions/regions, most-relevant first.

authority_hierarchy.description: LIBRARY KEY — source-authority tiers, ORDERED highest to lowest.

sources.description: LIBRARY KEY — source registry grouped by tier.

glossary.description: LIBRARY KEY — domain terminology the agent should use/expand.

compliance_rules.description: LIBRARY KEY — non-negotiable rules skills must honour.

confidence_tiers.description: LIBRARY KEY — authority level to user-facing confidence label.
